passive.name: Lightslinger
passive.text: Whenever Lucian uses an ability, his next attack becomes a double-shot. When Lucian is healed or shielded by an ally, or when a nearby enemy Champion is immobilized, his next 2 basic attacks will deal bonus magic damage.

spells.name: Piercing Light
spells.text: Lucian shoots a bolt of piercing light through a target.

spells.name: Ardent Blaze
spells.text: Lucian shoots a missile that explodes in a star shape, marking and briefly revealing enemies. Lucian gains Move Speed for attacking marked enemies.

spells.name: Relentless Pursuit
spells.text: Lucian quickly dashes a short distance. Lightslinger attacks reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown.

spells.name: The Culling
spells.text: Lucian unleashes a torrent of shots from his weapons.

damage.value: Lucian deals burst bonus magic damage with his next two basic attacks after an ally heals or shields him or a nearby enemy Champion is immobilized.

archetype.value: Lucian is a mobile marksman who follows abilities with double-shot basic attacks.

axis.value: Lucian can take short trades by using an ability and following it with a Lightslinger attack.

spikes.why: Lucian can dash for no cost on a 14-second cooldown.

bait.why: Lucian cannot dash with Relentless Pursuit again while it is on cooldown.
